metric: fraction of all 16 native episodes ending in strict physical placement; eight box and eight cylinder starts; aborted and timed-out episodes count as zero
policy: Public V4 solve.sh through the same Solver, strict wire validation, sensory sensitivity and independent MuJoCo worlds used by the scorer.

cohorts.N0: one official ale validate with null anchor, use oracle strict placements as denominator count
cohorts.N1,N2,N3: three independent fresh-seed ALE oracle panels with null anchor, no performance retries
cohorts.G0,G1: two independent ale validate invocations after anchor freeze; report all outcomes.

full_at: max(1, min(N0_placements, N1_placements, N2_placements, N3_placements) - 1) / N0_placements
interpretation: One whole episode (1/16) of sampling allowance below the observed minimum; report the resulting required successful episodes and all four individual counts.
zero_denominator: Stop and report an unusable anchor if N0_placements equals zero.
notes: Pre-keyed interface pilot and separate keyed V4/P1/open-loop diagnostics contribute no calibration observations. Neither G0 nor G1 changes value, full_at or the probe gate.
